literal_meaning: নাচা এবং কুঁদে ওঠা বা আনন্দময় খেলাধুলা
figurative_meaning_en: Amusement, joy, frolicking, fun and games
example_sentences_in_bangla: উৎসবে সবাই নাচনকোঁদন করে আনন্দ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The children are frolicking in the courtyard.
Everyone had fun and games at the festival.
note: This idiom evokes playful, carefree enjoyment typical in Bengali folk expressions.
